name: chat-seek
description: Find the Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode conversation you remember describing.

commands.title: Chat Seek: Search past AI chats

chatSeek.extraRoots.description: Additional Claude, Codex, or OpenCode history roots, including Windows mounts.

chatSeek.useLaya.description: Rerank search results with a local Laya model. First use downloads about 1.7 GB of model weights.

chatSeek.maxRerank.description: Maximum candidate messages scored by Laya per search.

chatSeek.summaries.enabled.description: Send sampled chat excerpts to configured providers for cached one-sentence summaries. API charges and provider data policies apply.

chatSeek.summaries.provider.description: Auto tries only configured providers: OpenAI, OpenRouter, TensorX, custom. Select one provider to disable cross-provider fallback.

chatSeek.summaries.openaiModel.description: Model ID for openai chat summaries.

chatSeek.summaries.openrouterModel.description: Model ID for openrouter chat summaries.

chatSeek.summaries.tensorxModel.description: Model ID for tensorx chat summaries.

chatSeek.summaries.customModel.description: Model ID for custom chat summaries.

chatSeek.summaries.customUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL ending in /v1. HTTPS required except localhost.

scripts.lint: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/indexer.js && node --check src/search.js && node --check src/webview.js && node --check src/summaries.js && node --check src/presentation.js
